    grid:
      body-width: 794px      # A4 width (210 mm at 96 dpi): the title block reads as a datasheet page

  - text: "<style>.navbar-brand, .navbar-nav, .navbar-toggler, #quarto-search { display: none !important; }</style>"
date-modified: last-modified
date-format: "YYYY-MM"       # feeds the REV stamp
